versions.content: If LinIf_ HeaderIndication is called while the indication of a response reception or the confirmation of a response transmis sion is expected, the LIN Interface shall consider the received frame as lost. Therefore, the LIN Interface shall report the runtime error code LINIF_E_RESPONSE to the Default Error Tracer . Afterwards, the received LIN Header shall be processed.

If LinIf_ HeaderInd ication is called while the indication of a response reception is expected, the LIN Interface shall consider the received frame as lost. Therefore, the LIN Interface shall report the runtime error code LINIF_E_RESPONSE to the Default Error Tracer . Afterwar ds, the received LIN Header shall be processed.
